calc_ap: calculate average precision from recall and precision rate arrays using COCO-style interpolation
calc_recall: calculate the recall rate given a count of true positives and total targets
calc_localization_scores: calculate 6D object localization performance scores including per-object and per-scene recall
calc_pose_detection_scores: calculate per-object average precision scores for 6D object pose detection with confidence-ranked detections
run_calc_ap_test: run the built-in test that computes average precision from a sample true/false positive array
